visual_inspection.observation: Current input remains visible; literal earlier markup wraps inside the feedback area. Capture is QA output, not a creative asset or human readability review.

limits: The server handler controls outcomes; this is not a real network-loss study or production reliability validation.
Recovery text lasts only until another submission or reload. No automatic retry, clipboard operation, extra control or persistent store is added.
Manual resending may duplicate an already broadcast message; feedback instructs checking the conversation first.
Human copy/readability, assistive technology, other browsers, adoption and paid demand remain unverified.
Working-client acceptance is a controlled compatibility probe, not an independent candidate attempt or model score.
P10 runtime and known-artifact calibration were not rerun locally; their existing records remain historical.
